verses.raw: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
verses.text: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.

verses.raw: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
verses.text: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
